method: One bounded read-only Firecrawl scrape of the official NFU scholarship landing page, plus one explicitly pinned accepted P3 discovery observation. No crawl, interaction, authentication, form submission, applicant-data collection, provider contact, or spreadsheet access occurred.
limitations: The P4 observation proves only what the named public URL returned in this bounded scrape. It establishes source architecture and link relationships for deterministic verification scenarios; scenario field values remain sanitized fixtures and are not accepted scholarship corrections.

observations.observed: The returned National Farmers Union scholarship page identified three separately named scholarship opportunities, presented a unified online application link, and presented an official-site paper-application PDF link.
The accepted P3 observation recorded a discovery page that routed to an external marketplace while distinct providers retained award administration and terms.
